task.description: Implement any required frontend changes for OBS-04 timeline support in the web app. Verify whether UI/API integration for GET /instances/:id/timeline is required by current requirements and design artifacts. If required, implement timeline data fetching, types, state handling, and presentation updates using established frontend conventions (api client, query keys, role-aware UI behavior). If no frontend work is required for OBS-04, produce a PASS result with explicit evidence and rationale. Validate with npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run test, and npm run build in web/.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend coverage for OBS-04 is implemented where required by requirements/design
If no frontend delta is required, result includes explicit requirement/design evidence
Artifacts and issues are fully documented in handoff result

result.summary: Implemented required OBS-04 frontend timeline coverage for Instance Detail. Evidence: docs/BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md requires IN-UI-06 Timeline tab calling GET /instances/:id/timeline, and src/design/obs-04-instance-timeline.md defines timeline fields/pagination. Added typed timeline API integration, query state handling, timeline tab/feed presentation, and cursor-based load-more behavior. Completed required validations in web/: npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run test, npm run build (all pass).
